notification.subject: Something new in eimir.
auth.magic.subject: Your sign-in link for eimir.
auth.signup.subject: Confirm your email address for eimir.
auth.verification.subject: Confirm your email address for eimir.
auth.recovery.subject: Reset your password for eimir.
auth.magic.preheader: One tap on the button and you are in.
auth.magic.heading: Welcome back.
auth.magic.intro: Tap the button to sign in to eimir. You do not need a password for this.
auth.magic.reason: You are receiving this message because a sign-in link was requested for this email address.
auth.magic.ignore: Was that not you? Just delete this message. Nothing happens unless the link is used.
auth.signup.preheader: One tap on the button and you can continue in eimir.
auth.signup.heading: Great to have you here.
auth.signup.intro: Confirm your email address quickly and you can continue in eimir. Already have an account? Then this simply signs you in.
auth.signup.reason: You are receiving this message because this email address was entered in eimir. to create an account or sign in.
auth.signup.ignore: Was that not you? Just delete this message. Without your confirmation no account is created and nothing changes.
auth.verification.preheader: One tap on the button and this address safely belongs to your account.
auth.verification.heading: Is this your address?
auth.verification.intro: Confirm your email address so it safely belongs to your eimir. account.
auth.verification.reason: You are receiving this message because confirming this email address was requested in your eimir. account.
auth.verification.ignore: Was that not you? Just delete this message. Nothing changes unless the link is used.
auth.recovery.preheader: Set a new password with one tap.
auth.recovery.heading: Set a new password
auth.recovery.intro: Tap the button to set a new password for your eimir. account. For your security, all signed-in devices are signed out afterwards.
auth.recovery.reason: You are receiving this message because a password reset was requested for this email address.
auth.recovery.ignore: Was that not you? Just delete this message; your password stays unchanged. If you are worried about your account, write to us.
mail.validity.minute: The link is valid for {count} minute and can only be used once.
mail.validity.minutes: The link is valid for {count} minutes and can only be used once.
mail.validity.hour: The link is valid for {count} hour and can only be used once.
mail.validity.hours: The link is valid for {count} hours and can only be used once.
mail.fallback: The button does not work? Copy this link into your browser's address bar:
mail.security: Security tip: do not share the link with anyone. eimir. never asks for your password by email.
mail.service: This message is part of your sign-in. It contains no advertising.
mail.privacy: We use your email address to send you this message. You can read more in the privacy notice.
notification.preheader: Open eimir. to see what is new.
notification.heading: There is something new for you.
notification.intro: Open eimir. to see what it is. For privacy reasons this message does not say anything more.
notification.reason: You are receiving this message because you turned on email notifications for your eimir. account.
notification.ignore: Do not want this any more? Under “Which messages you get” you can turn off the emails in eimir.
deletion.subject: Your account deletion has started
deletion.preheader: You do not need to do anything.
deletion.heading: Your account deletion has begun.
deletion.intro:
You do not need to do anything. Access to your eimir. account has ended.

The rest of the deletion runs automatically under the applicable retention rules.
deletion.reason: You are receiving this message as a confirmation because deletion was requested for your eimir. account.
deletion.ignore: Was that not you? Please contact us right away.
mail.service.account: This message is part of your account. It contains no advertising.
